tasks.final_text: I recently went to my first Utah Mammoth game on Friday! It was very enjoyable and we had great seats from my friend's company. The introduction of the players was quite impressive and the atmosphere was wonderful. I would highly recommend going if you are a fan of live sports!

Shopper's World is an open-air shopping center in Framingham, Massachusetts. The original facilty (spelled Shoppers' World) is of historical significance as one of the first suburban shopping malls in the United States upon opening in 1951; though it had a central courtyard and covered walkways, it was not fully indoor.
